learning_outcomes.text: This course aims to provide insight into both analog and digital communication.
The student can explain the different modulation techniques and their applications.
The student can build and test an analog communication system.

syllabus_topics: Finding and building a circuit to measure the signals of the previous circuit in spectrum analysis
Connecting the modulator and demodulator together to obtain a complete communication system
Designing an FM demodulator using a Phase Locked Loop (PLL)

assessment_methods.method: Oral examination with prior preparation of a paper (resit)

assessment_rules: For the first examination opportunity in June, the assessment is 100% based on assignments. For the second examination opportunity in August, the assessment is a 100% oral examination with prior preparation of a paper. After the deliberation of the academic bachelor, a task will be assigned to the student. The practical execution and results of this task will be brought to the exam where the task will be demonstrated and explained. There are no partial transfers for this course.
bibliography: modern electronic communication, Jeffrey S. Beasly & G. Miller ISBN 0-13-129302-8
